headline: Rocket Pool has a long-delay registry-upgrade path, but T1 contract changes still route through the oDAO rather than broad token governance or a verified Security Council.

findings.text: RocketStorage at 0x1d8f8f00cfa6758d7bE78336684788Fb0ee0Fa46 is live and getGuardian() returns 0x0cCF14983364A7735d369879603930Afe10df21e. RocketDAOProtocol and RocketDAONodeTrusted both read bootstrap mode disabled, so the guardian bootstrap path was not treated as an active no-delay upgrade path in this run.

Rocket Pool uses registry/EternalStorage-style upgrade indirection rather than a standard Transparent/UUPS/Beacon proxy path: RocketStorage exposes mutable registry/storage setters, RocketDAONodeTrustedProposals exposes proposalUpgrade(), and RocketDAONodeTrustedUpgrade exposes upgrade(), execute(), bootstrapUpgrade(), and veto().

The oDAO T1 upgrade path is RocketDAONodeTrustedProposals proposalUpgrade()/vote()/execute() into RocketDAONodeTrustedUpgrade upgrade()/execute(). The oDAO timing reads return getVoteDelayTime=604800, getVoteTime=1209600, and getExecuteTime/getActionTime=2419200 seconds; the uncontested credited path is therefore at least 4233600 seconds, or 49 days.

RocketDAONodeTrusted reports 10 members, getMemberMinRequired=3, and getMemberQuorumVotesRequired=5100000000000000000. This was assessed as a committee-governance actor, not a fetched Safe; signer identities and insider/non-insider classifications were not fully verified, so it was not credited as a Security Council.

The pDAO proposal system is separate from the oDAO code-upgrade path. RocketDAOProtocolSettingsProposals reads getVoteDelayTime=604800, getVotePhase1Time=604800, getVotePhase2Time=604800, getExecuteTime=2419200, getProposalQuorum=150000000000000000, and getProposalVetoQuorum=200000000000000000; RocketDAOProtocolProposal exposes propose(), vote(), finalise(), execute(), destroy(), and overrideVote().

RocketDAONodeTrustedUpgrade exposes veto() and an UpgradeVetoed event, indicating a veto/emergency surface, but the current veto actor membership and exact emergency scope were not fully enumerated from pinned on-chain addresses in this run.

The highest reachable tier is T1 because the oDAO proposal/upgrade surface includes proposalUpgrade() plus upgrade()/execute() and ContractUpgraded/ContractAdded events against the protocol contract registry. The no-delay bootstrapUpgrade() ABI surface exists, but deployed bootstrap-mode reads were disabled.

steelman.red: The red case would be a live guardian or opaque admin able to execute T1 upgrades immediately; deployed bootstrap flags read disabled and no active no-delay upgrade admin was found on the pinned path.
steelman.orange: The orange case is that T1 registry upgrades are reachable through the oDAO committee rather than broad token governance or a verified Security Council, even though a long delay is present.
steelman.green: The green case is the long uncontested delay, the disabled bootstrap path, and separate pDAO token-governed parameter flow; it would fit green if the T1 path were broad token governance or a verified Security Council.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because the evidence shows a delayed T1 upgrade path, but the controlling actor for contract-code upgrades is the oDAO committee and this run did not verify that it satisfies the Security Council standard or that T1 upgrades are executed through broad token governance.

evidence.shows: Capability probe succeeded; the page identifies Rocket Pool as a decentralised staking protocol providing liquid and node staking products for Ethereum.

RocketStorage surfacer at pinned block 25086075 shows getDeployedStatus=true, getGuardian() returning 0x0cCF14983364A7735d369879603930Afe10df21e, and mutable write methods including setAddress, setBool, setBytes, setString, and setUint.

RocketDAOProtocol surfacer shows getBootstrapModeDisabled=true and bootstrap-only write methods including bootstrapSettingAddress, bootstrapSettingBool, bootstrapSettingClaimer, bootstrapSettingMulti, bootstrapSettingUint, and bootstrapSpendTreasury.

RocketDAONodeTrusted surfacer at pinned block 25246507 shows getBootstrapModeDisabled=true, getMemberCount=10, getMemberMinRequired=3, getMemberQuorumVotesRequired=5100000000000000000, and bootstrap-only write methods.
RocketDAONodeTrustedProposals surfacer at pinned block 25246507 shows proposalUpgrade, proposalSettingBool, proposalSettingUint, vote, cancel, and execute entrypoints.

RocketDAONodeTrustedUpgrade surfacer at pinned block 25246507 shows write methods bootstrapUpgrade, execute, upgrade, and veto, plus ContractAdded, ContractUpgraded, UpgradePending, and UpgradeVetoed events.
RocketDAONodeTrustedSettingsProposals surfacer at pinned block 25246507 shows getVoteDelayTime=604800, getVoteTime=1209600, getExecuteTime=2419200, getActionTime=2419200, and getCooldownTime=172800.
RocketDAOProtocolProposal surfacer at pinned block 25246510 shows pDAO proposal functions including propose, vote, finalise, execute, destroy, and overrideVote, and getTotal()=7.

RocketDAOProtocolSettingsProposals surfacer at pinned block 25246510 shows pDAO settings: getVoteDelayTime=604800, getVotePhase1Time=604800, getVotePhase2Time=604800, getExecuteTime=2419200, getProposalQuorum=150000000000000000, and getProposalVetoQuorum=200000000000000000.
Official Rocket Pool smart-contract repository; repository description states Rocket Pool is a decentralised Ethereum liquid staking protocol.
ConsenSys Diligence audit page for Rocket Pool dated April 2021.
Rocket Pool DAO forum page states the forum is dedicated to governance discussions, protocol improvement proposals, and community-led initiatives.

unknowns: C1: owner/admin/pendingOwner/governor methods were not present or not useful on several Rocket Pool registry-style contracts; control was assessed through RocketStorage.getGuardian, bootstrap-mode flags, oDAO membership/quorum reads, and deployed proposal/upgrade ABIs.
C2: exact source-level restrictions and all non-upgradable carve-outs in the registry-upgrade mechanism were not re-verified from a pinned commit in this run.

C3: exact source-level use of getExecuteTime versus getActionTime in the oDAO post-vote upgrade path was not reconstructed from a pinned commit; both read as 2419200 seconds, so the assessment credits the conservative 604800+1209600+2419200 uncontested delay.
C4: oDAO member identities and insider/non-insider classifications were not fully enumerated; therefore the oDAO was not credited as a Security Council.
C5: pDAO proposer eligibility/proposal-threshold semantics beyond the proposal bond/quorum/veto-quorum/timing constants were not fully determined from on-chain reads.
C6: RocketDAONodeTrustedUpgrade exposes veto and UpgradeVetoed, but the current veto actor membership and exact emergency scope were not fully enumerated from pinned on-chain addresses.

C7: exact callable payload set for pDAO proposals was not decoded from proposal payload history; pDAO was classified only as parameter/treasury governance based on pinned role context and deployed ABI shape.

protocol_metadata.about: Rocket Pool lets ETH holders stake into the protocol and receive rETH, a liquid staking receipt that accrues staking rewards and can be redeemed or used elsewhere. Node operators supply lower-capital validator stakes while the protocol pairs them with pooled ETH, with governance and oracle machinery managing upgrades, parameters, and network reporting.
